messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered P#12345 — ingress gateway (eu-west) reporting elevated 5xx (502/504) starting ~03:12Z. On-call: morgan. Severity: sev2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/P12345
morgan: Picking this up. I'm seeing ~30% 502s on /v1/generate across multiple edge nodes. Confirming impact now.
lex: Correlating traces — spike aligns with a sudden rise in long-lived connections to a small backend pool. No recent deploys.
nana: (typo) Ana: Logs show repeated `upstream reset: connection reset by peer` and `http: header too large` on some streams. A subset of clients have sticky routing headers.
ev an: Evan: quick telemetry: 502s concentrated on client-id prefixes acct-4xx and acct-49*. Bucketed errors mostly backend 1/4 hosts.
morgan: Any config flips in the last hour?
lex: No infra deploys. No config rollouts. Looks like connection churn + sticky affinity causing some backends to exhaust workers.
nana: Ana: Sample log snippet: ```[03:13:02Z] svc=api-gw node=eu-west-3 upstream=10.2.5.12 err="connection reset by peer" hdrs="x-client-id:acct-498 keepalive:1"```
evan: Suggest short-term mitigations: 1) enable random-failover routing for /v1/generate for 10m, 2) toggle upstream keepalive off for eu-west pool, 3) enable circuit-breaker at LB for aggressive failover.
morgan: Applying mitigation 1 now: `rwctl route set /v1/generate --fallback=randomized --duration=10m`
incident-bot: Route change applied by morgan at 03:17Z.
tara: Tara: I'll prep keepalive toggle if morgan wants it. Disabling keepalive helped similar incident last quarter.
morgan: Toggling keepalive off on eu-west pool: `infractl pool update eu-west --keepalive=false` rolling to 6 nodes.
nana: After fallback + keepalive off p50 latency down 70%, 502s dropped from 30% -> ~6% in 5m window. Some sticky client streaks persist.
evan: Also applied LB circuit-breaker: `lbctl cb set --threshold=10 --window=60 --action=failover` for eu-west cluster.
morgan: Noted persistent customer impact for acct-498 (roughly 1200 failed requests). customer-ops, please contact the account.
customer-ops: Notified support and emailed the customer with recommended client retry-backoff and info we rolled mitigations. Opening CS ticket CS-7281.
lex: Root-cause hypothesis: sudden client-side reuse of keepalive + affinity headers led to uneven load on a few backends; backend worker queue exhaustion then TCP resets -> 502s. Also observed larger-than-expected header payloads for some clients triggering header-parsing errors in the proxy.
tara: Action items for postmortem: - add soft-eviction for sticky sessions, - add header-size alerts, - consider per-client connection limits, - add automated fallback rule when per-backend error > X%.
morgan: Handing off monitoring/hunt to lex at 04:10Z. I'll keep mitigation flags active for 30m. Leaving a short runbook note: `mitigation: fallback+routing + keepalive=false + cb=enabled`.
lex: Ack. I'll drive RCA and coordinate with runtime + infra to schedule fixes. Tagging runtime and infra teams for follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident P#12345 moved to "monitoring" state at 04:12Z. Responders: morgan, lex, ana, evan, tara, customer-ops.
(brief silence)
morgan: Closing the live triage thread — will reopen if errors resurge.
